notes.title: Experience the Adrenaline rush - Ski jumping Pro VR released today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247680/f6603fb9734c4c937b8b9da95e6fca92578cc516.png[/img]

[b][i]Feel the extreme height and speed on PSVR & Steam VR[/i][/b]

Kalypso Media and Yippee Entertainment are excited to announce that sports simulation title, Ski Jumping Pro VR is now available for Playstation VR and Steam VR.

In perfect time for the start of the Ski Jumping World Cup, Ski Jumping Pro VR lets you experience the extreme ups and perilous downs of professional ski jumping like no other game.

Witness the gravity-defying thrills and spills in the all-new release trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZOZaNnqmrg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063470/Ski_Jumping_Pro_VR/

Set out on your journey as a relative unknown in Career or Quick Jump modes and aim for the pinnacle of Ski Jumpings most prestigious competitions, like World Champion and two-time Olympic Gold Medalist, Andreas Wellinger. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247680/175d34515c25877241dc1321528a77295437d3c9.jpg[/img]
Ski Jumping Pro: Andreas Wellinger - Two-time Olympic Gold Medalist
and World Champion

“When you’re at the top of the hill in a big competition, the adrenaline rush hits you and you know that a good jump can put you in contention, but equally the slightest error could end in disaster. You get the same feeling in Ski Jumping Pro VR” said Andreas Wellinger.

Compete in events over 32 venues, all meticulously created from their real-life equivalents, and battle the elements as you jump in wintery and blustery conditions in both day and night-time tournaments.

Andreas Wellinger continues, “The venues in Ski Jumping Pro VR are breathtaking. You really feel the elation from the crowd when you stick a landing because the locations are so true to life. The hill, the lights, the views. It’s all so accurate”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247680/76fc69d87d7e308bcd871002b8743c313404cb65.jpg[/img]

Upgrade as you progress with the deep character customisation to improve your performance and style to become a true pro in the ultimate winter sports simulation.
